title: Privacy Policy
content_html:
Orgiast Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "the Company") recognizes the importance of personal information entrusted to us by customers in the provision of services, complies with the Act on the Protection of Personal Information and other relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines, and handles personal information appropriately based on the following policy.

2. Personal Information Collected

The Company collects the following information on this website.

(1) Information entered by customers

The Company collects the following information through inquiry forms, document request forms, quotation request forms, etc.

  • Company name / organization name, department name, job title
  • Name
  • Email address, telephone number
  • Address (if necessary for quotation or document delivery)
  • Details of consultation such as the planned exhibition name, exhibition period, venue, and number of booths
  • Other content entered in the form input fields

(2) Information automatically obtained through customer operations

  • IP address, browser type/version, OS, referrer URL, pages viewed, date and time of viewing
  • Identifiers assigned via cookies and similar technologies

This information does not include personally identifiable information, but if it can be combined with other information to identify a specific individual, it will be handled as personal information.

(3) Information provided by telephone, meetings, etc.

Information provided through telephone calls, emails, online meetings, exchange of business cards at exhibition venues or upon visiting your company, etc.

3. Purposes of Use

The Company will use the collected personal information within the scope of the following purposes.

  1. 1. Responding to and contacting customers regarding inquiries, document requests, and quotation requests
  2. 2. Execution of operations related to the planning, design, production, setup, dismantling, and storage of the Company's services
  3. 3. Procedures necessary for acting as an agent for various applications and registrations with event and exhibition organizers, venues, etc.
  4. 4. Accounting operations such as contract conclusion and execution, billing, and payment processing
  5. 5. Sending information on the Company's services, exhibition participation information, and notices regarding seminars and exhibitions (via email, postal mail, telephone, etc.)
  6. 6. Implementation of surveys and analysis for improving service quality
  7. 7. Analysis of website usage status, improvement of the browsing environment, and measurement of advertising effectiveness
  8. 8. Publication as production records (limited to cases where prior consent of the customer has been obtained）
  9. 9. Execution of operations incidental to each of the above items

*If you do not wish to receive the notices described in item 5, please use the unsubscribe link included in each email or contact us via theInquiry Contact Point in Article 13. We will promptly stop sending them.

4. Changes to Purposes of Use

If the Company changes the purposes of use, it will do so only within a scope reasonably recognized as having relevance to the purposes before the change, and will promptly announce the changes on this website.

5. Provision to Third Parties

Except in the following cases, the Company will not provide personal information to any third party without obtaining the prior consent of the individual.

  1. When required by law
  2. When it is necessary for the protection of a person's life, body, or property, and obtaining the individual's consent is difficult
  3. When it is particularly necessary for improving public health or promoting the healthy development of children, and obtaining the individual's consent is difficult
  4. When it is necessary to cooperate with a national agency, local government, or a person commissioned by them in performing affairs stipulated by law, and obtaining the individual's consent may hinder the execution of such affairs
  5. When personal information is provided in connection with the succession of a business due to a merger or other reasons

Note thatWhen we act as an agent for applications or registrations with the exhibition organizer, venue operator, security company, transport company, etc., in connection with exhibiting at a trade show, we will provide your information to the extent necessary for such procedures.. This provision will be carried out based on your request and after we have informed you in advance of the recipients and the details of the information to be provided.

6. Outsourcing

We may outsource all or part of the handling of personal information to external parties within the scope necessary to achieve the purposes of use. In such cases, we will thoroughly verify the eligibility of the outsourcing contractor, obligate them to appropriately handle personal information in the contract, and exercise necessary and appropriate supervision.

Main types of outsourcing contractors: partner companies for event production, booth construction, installation, transport, and storage; printing companies; website and form operation and maintenance providers; email distribution and customer management system providers.

7. Provision to Third Parties in Foreign Countries / Understanding of the Foreign Environment

We utilize services provided by entities located in foreign countries for the operation of this website, access analysis, email distribution, and the use of business systems, and personal data may be stored on these services.

Service UsedProviderCountry of Storage
Access Analysis: Google Analytics / Google Search ConsoleGoogle LLCUnited States of America
Business Systems: Google WorkspaceGoogle LLCUnited States of America

We understand the systems for protecting personal information in these countries and take necessary and appropriate measures for security management.

8. Use of Cookies and Access Analysis Tools

This website uses cookies and similar technologies to provide you with better services.

(1) What are Cookies

Small text files saved to your browser when you visit a website. Cookies alone cannot identify you as an individual.

(2) Purpose of Use

Used to understand and improve site usage, optimize your browsing environment, and for advertisement delivery and effectiveness measurement.

(3) Tools Used

  • Google Analytics (Google LLC)
    Used to collect and analyze traffic data. Data is collected anonymously and does not identify individuals. For details, please check theGoogle Privacy Policyand theGoogle Analytics Terms of Service. If you do not wish for this data collection, please use theGoogle Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

(4) How to Reject Cookies

You can disable cookies via your browser settings. However, doing so may prevent you from using some functions of this website.

(5) Provision of Personally Related Information to Third Parties

When we provide browsing history etc. (personally related information) obtained via cookies to a third party in a manner that anticipates the recipient will acquire it as personal data, we will confirm in advance that the consent of the individual concerned has been obtained.

9. Security Control Measures

We take the following measures to prevent the leakage, loss, or damage of personal information and to otherwise ensure the security management of personal information.

  • Establishment of Basic Policy: We have established this policy, which stipulates compliance with laws and regulations and establishes a contact point for inquiries and complaints.
  • Development of Internal Regulations: We have established handling methods and responsible persons for each stage of acquisition, use, storage, provision, and deletion/disposal.
  • Organizational Security Measures: We have appointed a person responsible for handling personal information and established a system to check the handling status. We have established a reporting and contact system for when facts violating laws or this policy are discovered.
  • Human Resource Security Measures: We provide employees with education on the handling of personal information and stipulate matters regarding confidentiality in our work regulations, etc.
  • Physical Security Measures: We implement measures for controlling entry/exit in areas where personal information is handled, preventing theft of devices and documents, and preventing leakage when items are carried out.
  • Technical Security Measures: We limit the scope of personnel and the personal information they handle through access control, and have introduced mechanisms to protect against unauthorized external access or malicious software. Communications on this website are encrypted using SSL/TLS.
  • Understanding of the Foreign Environment: When handling personal data in a foreign country, we understand the personal information protection system of that country and implement security control measures (seeArticle 7）。

10. Requests for Disclosure, Correction, Suspension of Use, etc. of Retained Personal Data

The individual concerned or their agent may request notification of the purpose of use, disclosure (including by providing electronic records), correction, addition, or deletion of content, suspension of use or erasure, and suspension of provision to third parties regarding personal data retained by us.

Procedure

  1. Inquiry Contact Point in Article 13. Please contact us. We will inform you of the prescribed request form and required documents.
  2. Please submit documents that can verify your identity (copies of driver's license, health insurance card, etc.). In the case of a request by an agent, a power of attorney and documents verifying the identity of the agent are required.
  3. After confirmation via our prescribed procedures, we will respond within a reasonable period.

Note that if disclosure is not possible under laws and regulations, or if disclosure may harm the rights and interests of a third party, we will notify you to that effect along with the reason.

11. Retention Period and Disposal of Personal Information

We retain personal information only for the period necessary to achieve the purposes of use and the period required for retention by law. After this period has elapsed, we will promptly dispose of or erase the information using an irrecoverable method.

12. Response in the Event of a Leak, etc.

In the event of a leak, loss, damage, or other situation that may harm the rights and interests of an individual concerning personal data, we will promptly report to the Personal Information Protection Commission and notify the individual concerned in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

13. Contact Point for Inquiries

For questions regarding the handling of personal information, requests for disclosure, etc., or complaints, please contact the following contact point.

Contact PointOrgiast Co., Ltd. Administration Department
Address〒537-0001 Osaka Prefecture, Osaka City, Higashinari Ward, Fukae Kita 2-15-24 Toho Building 212
Phone0120-487-121
Reception HoursWeekdays 09:00–18:00 (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, national holidays, and year-end/new year holidays)

14. Changes to This Policy

The Company may change this policy in response to amendments to laws or regulations, changes in services, or other reasons. The revised content shall become effective as of the time it is posted on this website. In the case of material changes, we will notify you on this website.
